scripts.text:
[Dewata Sailor]
Do you want to visit ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000?
With its dazzling waves and charming vistas it's a great place to relax.
The transit fee is 10,000 Zeny and 1,000 for VIP.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他水手]
您想去^8B4513德瓦他岛^000000吗？
那里有着迷人的海浪和风景，是放松身心的好地方。
中转费用为10,000 Zeny，VIP费用为1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Dewata Sailor]
Do you want to visit ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000?
With its dazzling waves and charming vistas it's a great place to relax.
The transit fee is 10,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他水手]
您想去^8B4513德瓦他岛^000000吗？
那里有着迷人的海浪和风景，是放松身心的好地方。
中转费用为10,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Dewata Sailor]
^8B4513Dewata^000000 is a beautiful and peaceful island country.
Have a nice trip~
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他水手]
^8B4513德瓦他^000000是一个美丽而宁静的岛国。
祝您旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[Dewata Sailor]
You don't have the dough, kid.
Come back when you have a bigger wallet.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他水手]
你的钱不够啊，小鬼。
等你钱包鼓一点再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Dewata Sailor]
Let me know
when you're ready to travel~
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他水手]
准备好出发了就告诉我~

scripts.text:
[Alberta Sailor]
Do you want to go back to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔贝塔水手]
您想回到艾尔贝塔吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Sailor]
I hope you had a lot of fun on
your trip to ^8B4513Dewata^000000 Island.
Please come again!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔贝塔水手]
希望您能在^8B4513德瓦他^000000岛玩得开心。
欢迎再次光临！

scripts.text:
[Alberta Sailor]
Have some more fun before you go.
^8B4513Dewata^000000 Island still has more to offer.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔贝塔水手]
走之前再多玩一会儿吧。
^8B4513德瓦他^000000岛还有很多值得探索的地方。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
What's wrong with your faaaaaace? You must really be clueless!
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
你的脸怎么了？看来你真的很无知啊！

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Let me drop some knowledge on ya.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
让我给你普及点知识吧。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
I may be a youngling, but no one knows more than I do about ^777700Palm fruit^000000. All right! What do you want to know?
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
虽然我年纪小，但关于^777700棕榈果^000000，没人比我更懂。说吧！你想了解什么？

scripts.text: About the shell...
scripts.translation: 关于果壳...

scripts.text: About the pulp...
scripts.translation: 关于果肉...

scripts.text: About the palm kernel...
scripts.translation: 关于棕榈仁...

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
So you want to know about Palm fruit's pulp? Let me explain.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
你想了解棕榈果的果肉？让我来解释一下。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Normally Palm fruit shell is used for making oil. Palm Oil is a useful ingredient for many dishes.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
通常棕榈果的果壳用来榨油。棕榈油是许多菜肴的有用原料。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Hmm... Have you met Memo already? Then it should be easy for you to understand.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
嗯...你见过备忘吗？如果是那样，你应该很容易理解。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
If you want to know how to use Palm Oil, go find Memo on the north side of Dewata island. Everyday, he makes traditional drinks with Palm Oil.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
如果你想知道如何使用棕榈油，去德瓦他岛北边找备忘。他每天都会用棕榈油制作传统饮品。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Anyways, we refer to the oil that comes from the Palm fruit as Palm oil or Coconut oil, which is well known for it's quality.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
总之，我们从棕榈果中提取的油被称为棕榈油或椰子油，以品质优良而闻名。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
The leftovers from oil production gets dried, and used for fuel in cooking or heating.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
榨油后的残渣会被晒干，用作烹饪或取暖的燃料。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
It burns well and has a good smell, can't get better than that.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
燃烧效果很好，而且闻起来很香，简直完美。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Ok!! That is all about the pulp, it takes too long to explain all those useful effects for Palm fruit shells.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
好了！关于果肉的介绍就到这里，要讲完棕榈果壳的所有用途可太花时间了。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
It's not like this is the extent of my knowledge. Don't get me wrong!
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
别误会，我的知识可不止这些！

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
So you want to know about the Palm interior? Let me explain.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
那么，你想了解棕榈果的内部吗？让我来解释一下。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Palm tree fruit has 2 layers of pulp. Outside is very rough, and the inside is smooth...
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
棕榈果的果肉分为两层。外层非常粗糙，而内层则很光滑...

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Hmm... Yes! the pulp of Palm tree fruit is a little bit harder than a walnut shell, must be the water it contains inside.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
嗯...是的！棕榈果的果肉比核桃壳稍微硬一点，这大概是因为里面含有水分吧。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Inside of the shell, there's about 300cc water which is useful in quenching people's thirst since Dewata island has very hot weather.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
果壳里面大约有300cc的水，在德瓦他这样炎热的天气里，用来解渴非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
And it's not like we just throw it away once we drink the water inside!!
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
而且，喝完里面的水后，我们可不会直接把它扔掉！！

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
We also can make a quality canteen out of it! Like I said, it has really thick outer shell enough and can act as a water bottle.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
我们还能用它制作优质的水壶！就像我说的，它的外壳足够厚实，完全可以当作水瓶使用。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
It is also great to make charcoal. Charcoal made out of palm fruit is well known for long lasting and quality fire,
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
它也非常适合制作木炭。用棕榈果制成的木炭以燃烧持久、品质优良而闻名。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
People love to cook seafoods and chicken with Palm fruit charcoal..
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
人们喜欢用棕榈果木炭来烤海鲜和鸡肉...

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
It has the extra bonus of being burning with a pleasant palm smell
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
它还有一个额外的优点，就是燃烧时会散发出宜人的棕榈香味。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Ok!! That is all for pulp information, it takes too long to explain all those useful effects.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
好了！关于果肉的介绍就到这里，要讲完所有用途可太花时间了。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
It's not like this is all I know. Don't get me wrong!
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
别误会，我知道的可不止这些！

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
So, you want to know about tender kernel inside? Let me explain for you
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
那么，你想了解里面柔软的果核吗？让我为你解释一下。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
The kernel inside of the hard pulp is used as a natural digestive.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
坚硬果肉里面的果核，被用作天然的助消化剂。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Not much to say about the kernel inside..
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
关于里面的果核，也没什么好说的...

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
but we do make sure to use every part of the palm fruit.
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
但我们确实会利用棕榈果的每一部分。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Wouldn't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
你不觉得是这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Arrgg! You have no interest in the world!
scripts.translation:
[水果爱好者]
啊！你对这个世界毫无兴趣！

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
Why are you carrying so much? Isn't it heavy?
scripts.translation:
[懒散的年轻人]
你背了这么多东西？不重吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
Wewt~!! Isn't that Palm Juice?
Can you give me that? I just woke
up, and my throat is parched!
scripts.translation:
[懒散的年轻人]
哇~！！那不是棕榈汁吗？
能给我喝一点吗？我刚睡醒，嗓子干得要命！

scripts.text: Give
scripts.translation: 给他

scripts.text: Do not give
scripts.translation: 不给

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
Really? For me?? I'll give you this in return... Thanks... Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[懒散的年轻人]
真的吗？给我？那我回赠你一点这个... 谢谢... 嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
So be it~ Ok...
scripts.translation:
[懒散的年轻人]
好吧~ 行吧...

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
Ah~ Thristy~ Anyone have some Palm
juice for me?~
scripts.translation:
[懒散的年轻人]
啊~ 好渴~ 谁有棕榈汁给我喝一点？~

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
Arrgg~ I'm thirsty~~ so thirsty~~
Give me Palm juice... Palm Juuiice~~
scripts.translation:
[懒散的年轻人]
啊~ 好渴~~ 太渴了~~
给我点棕榈汁... 棕榈汁~~

scripts.text:
[Nasolo]
Wow~ Pure ocean, a warm beach...
Perfect for a date with a girlfriend...
scripts.translation:
[纳索洛]
哇~ 纯净的海洋，温暖的海滩...
简直太适合和女朋友约会了...

scripts.text:
[Nasolo]
If only I had one...
scripts.translation:
[纳索洛]
要是我也有一个就好了...

scripts.text:
[Nasolo]
I wonder when my princess will come...
scripts.translation:
[纳索洛]
不知道我的公主什么时候会来...

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
You came to taste my dish? It is always good to eat with an empty stomach.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
你是来品尝我的菜的吗？空腹吃东西总是最棒的。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Welcome to the island of Dewata.
I hope you behave like a noble
traveler, unlike some of these
teenage punks...
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
欢迎来到德瓦他岛。
希望你能像高贵的旅行者那样举止得体，
别像这里那些朽魔一样...

scripts.text: About Dewata dishes
scripts.translation: 关于德瓦他料理

scripts.text: Today's menu?
scripts.translation: 今天的菜单？

scripts.text: I'm okay.
scripts.translation: 我没事

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Need info about our foods? Well... I don't have much to talk about, but feel free to listen if you want.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
需要了解我们的食物吗？嗯... 也没什么好说的，但如果你想听，请便。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
So much to cover, let me begin.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
内容很多，让我从头说起。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
First, Dewata dishes have special names based on each cooking recipe,
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
首先，德瓦他料理会根据每种烹饪方法拥有特殊的名称，

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
If dish name has 'Goreng' in it, then it is either stir or deep fried food.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
如果菜名里有“Goreng”，那就是炒或炸的食物。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
If it is a type of 'Bakar', then it is a grilled food.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
如果是“Bakar”类的，那就是烤制的食物。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
And if it's 'Satay', then you are eating a skewered dish.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
如果是“Satay”，那就是串烧料理。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Second, we have dishes named after basic ingredients,
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
其次，我们有些料理是以基本食材命名的，

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
In Dewata island, we call rice as Nasi, noodle as Mie, bread as Roti, chicken as Ayam, fish as Ikan, and corn as Jagung.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
在德瓦他岛上，我们称米饭为Nasi，面条为Mie，面包为Roti，鸡肉为Ayam，鱼为Ikan，玉米为Jagung。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
So, if rice is fried we call it 'Nasi Goreng', and fried noodle is 'Mie Goreng'.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
所以，炒米饭叫“Nasi Goreng”，炒面叫“Mie Goreng”。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Well... This is enough to enjoy our foods in Dewata!! If you are hungry, we have our special set menu for only ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
嗯... 这就足够让您在德瓦他尽享美食了！！如果您饿了，我们有特价套餐，仅需^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
We have 2 items 'Nasi Goreng' and 'Satay'. Which one do you want?
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
我们有两种菜品：“Nasi Goreng”和“Satay”。您想要哪一种？

scripts.text: Nasi Goreng
scripts.translation: Nasi Goreng

scripts.text: Satay
scripts.translation: Satay

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
This is Nasi Goreng fried with my special sauce plus egg fry on the top. It only costs ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
这是用我的特制酱汁炒制的Nasi Goreng，上面还煎了一个蛋。只要^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
This is the Satay, a slice of meat skewered and grilled over Palm fruit charcoal. It costs only ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
这是Satay，肉片串在签子上，用棕榈果炭火烤制。只要^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Taste
scripts.translation: 品尝

scripts.text: Walk away
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Where's the money kid? Sheesh! No free food here! Ok?
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
钱呢，小孩？天哪！这里没有免费的食物！懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Here's your {0}, you won't regret it!
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
这是您的{0}，您不会后悔的！

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
It's a shame you won't taste this great dish...
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
真遗憾，您尝不到这道美味佳肴...

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Are you serious? This is not even funny.
scripts.translation:
[餐馆老板]
你是认真的吗？这一点都不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Gourmet]
Oh... it's like a party in my
mouth... and everyone's invited!
scripts.translation:
[美食家]
噢... 就像嘴里开了一场派对...
而且所有人都被邀请了！

scripts.text:
[Gourmet]
Master~ One more please~
scripts.translation:
[美食家]
师父~ 再来一份~

scripts.text:
[Gourmet]
You must try this! The Food here is succulent~
scripts.translation:
[美食家]
你一定要尝尝！这里的食物鲜嫩多汁~

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Wow...
How many has he already eaten?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
哇...
他已经吃了多少了？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
He must be big eater, not the gourmet...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
他肯定是个大胃王，而不是美食家...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Have you been to Prontera yet? I think I've seen him somewhere..
scripts.translation:
[游客]
你去过普隆德拉吗？我觉得我在哪里见过他...

scripts.text:
[Guide]
This temple behind me is called Borobudur.
Borobudur temple was built in the 9th century
to venerate the Great Buddha, an ancient religious figure.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
我身后的这座寺庙叫做婆罗浮屠。
婆罗浮屠建于9世纪，用于供奉大佛，一位古老的宗教人物。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
This temple is made with 6 square platforms and 3 round platforms, and 2672 hand carved relief panels as well as 504 statue of various Buddhas.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
这座寺庙由6个方形平台和3个圆形平台组成，还有2672块手工雕刻的浮雕面板，以及504尊各种佛像。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
The central stupa, or shrine is located at the center of high platform, which is surrounded by 72 more statues.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
中央的佛塔，也就是神龛，位于最高平台的中心，周围环绕着72尊雕像。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Even in modern times Borobudur temple is a pilgrimage site for many monks worshiping the Buddha. It's also a major tourist attraction, as you can imagine.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
即使在现代，婆罗浮屠寺庙也是许多供奉佛陀的武僧的朝圣地。正如你可以想象的那样，它也是一个主要的旅游景点。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
That is all I have on Borobudur temple, are there any questions?
If not, we can move to the next spot.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
关于婆罗浮屠寺庙，我就介绍到这里了，有什么问题吗？
如果没有，我们可以去下一个景点了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh, dag-nabbit... I've gone and
picked the wrong tour guide...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
噢，该死...我选错了向导...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
This hombre is a real snooze...
Why make it longer..
scripts.translation:
[游客]
这家伙真让人犯困...
为什么要说这么多...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I need to change my travel agent...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我得换个旅行代理...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, let's go there! Hurry up,
while the tour guide is explaining~
scripts.translation:
[游客]
嘿，我们去那边吧！快点，趁向导还在讲解~

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Come on... It doesn't sound like
he's going to stop talking anytime soon.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
拜托...听起来他一时半会儿不会停下来的。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Aren't we going to get lost without the guide?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
没有向导我们不会迷路吗？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
We got lost already last time...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
上次我们就迷路了...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh~ This is very interesting. A
temple that worships the Buddha...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
噢~ 这很有趣。一座供奉佛陀的寺庙...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
But I don't really get all the
symbology here.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
但我并不太懂这里的象征意义。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So beautiful... I wonder who built
this place?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
真美...不知道是谁建造了这个地方？

scripts.text:
[Monk]
I am a monk, content to spend my days in religious study.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我是一名武僧，乐于在宗教研究中度过我的日子。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
I've just returned from a pilgrimage to Borobudur temple with my fellow monks...
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我刚和同门的武僧们一起从婆罗浮屠寺庙朝圣回来...

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Borobudur temple has many pilgrims visiting, since it is one of few temples left for worshipping the Great Buddha.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
婆罗浮屠寺庙有很多朝圣者来访，因为它是少数几个供奉大佛的寺庙之一。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Borobudur temple is one of few temples left for worshiping the Great Buddha.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
婆罗浮屠寺庙是少数几个供奉大佛的寺庙之一。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
I don't understand why there are only few temples left that follow our ways...
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我不明白，为什么遵循我们教义的寺庙只剩下这么少了...

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Are you a Tourist? You can make an offering and a wish to one of the shrines.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
你是游客吗？你可以向神龛供奉并许下愿望。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Our great Buddha may grant your wish..
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我们的大佛可能会实现你的愿望。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Our great Buddha is the king of souls and the leader of all good Gods.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我们的大佛是众灵之王，也是所有善神的领袖。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
The Dewata tribes believes in Buddha, the strange thing is they all describe Buddha as different creatures.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
德瓦他部落信仰佛陀，奇怪的是，他们都将佛陀描述成不同的生物。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
I'm not really sure about the reason for that. Maybe because there are many different tribes in Dewata with different characteristics.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我不太清楚原因。也许是因为德瓦他有许多不同的部落，各自有着不同的特征。

scripts.text: There is a small shrine here. There are many people making wishes.
scripts.translation: 这里有一座小神龛。有许多人在许愿。

scripts.text: Make a donation.
scripts.translation: 进行捐赠

scripts.text: Make a wish.
scripts.translation: 许下愿望

scripts.text: Walk away.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
Donation case says:
^FF00001,000 ~ 100,000 Zeny^000000
How much do you want to donate?
scripts.translation:
捐赠箱上写着：
^FF00001,000 ~ 100,000 Zeny^000000
您想捐赠多少？

scripts.text: - Cancelled. -
scripts.translation: - 已取消。-

scripts.text: - Not enough Zeny. -
scripts.translation: - Zeny不足。-

scripts.text: What is your wish?
scripts.translation: 您的愿望是什么？

scripts.text: You make a wish for ^0000FF{0}^000000 to the small shrine.
scripts.translation: 您向小神龛许下了^0000FF{0}^000000的愿望。

scripts.text: - A celestial entity gives you a blessing. -
scripts.translation: - 一个天界实体赐予了您祝福。-

scripts.text: - The shrine envelops you in a loving aura. -
scripts.translation: - 神龛将您笼罩在充满爱意的灵气中。-

scripts.text: It feels like this wish could come true.
scripts.translation: 感觉这个愿望可能会实现。

scripts.text: What is your wish?
scripts.translation: 您的愿望是什么？

scripts.text: You have made your wish for ^0000FF{0}^000000 to the small shrine.
scripts.translation: 您已向小神龛许下^0000FF{0}^000000的愿望。

scripts.text: It feels like this wish could come true.
scripts.translation: 感觉这个愿望可能会实现。

scripts.text: Mysterious energy comes out from the shrine.
scripts.translation: 神秘的能量从神龛中散发出来。

scripts.text: You have received the shrine's blessing.
scripts.translation: 您获得了神龛的祝福。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
You are a stranger here. What brings here to this quiet place?
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
您是这里的陌生人吧。是什么风把您吹到这宁静的地方来了？

scripts.text: I'm sightseeing.
scripts.translation: 我在观光

scripts.text: No reason.
scripts.translation: 没什么特别的原因

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Oh, you are a tourist. This is the '^0000FFPagoda^000000' worshiping the great Buddha. Please be respectful of the monks praying here.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
哦，原来您是游客。这里是供奉大佛的^0000FF宝塔^000000。请尊重在此祈祷的僧侣们。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Good day to you...
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
祝您有美好的一天...

scripts.text:
[Monk]
We have a pagoda for the worship of Buddhas. Each temple has one of these towers, though not many people come here besides other monks.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我们有一座供奉佛陀的宝塔。每座寺庙都有这样一座塔，不过除了其他僧侣外，很少有外人会来这里。

scripts.text: I see...
scripts.translation: 我明白了...

scripts.text: Explain about Buddhas
scripts.translation: 讲讲佛陀

scripts.text: Ah, okay.
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了

scripts.text:
[Monk]
You must feel the compassion of our Buddha!
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
您必须感受我们佛陀的慈悲！

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Buddha is our God from Dewata myth, he is the king of souls and also the leader of good Gods.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
佛陀是德瓦他神话中的神明，他是众灵之王，也是众善神的领袖。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Buddha is the guardian of souls whom often described in traditional dance as fighting against the magician Rangda.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
佛陀是灵魂的守护者，在传统舞蹈中，他常被描绘为与魔法师朗达战斗的形象。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
In Dewata we belive there are many deities protecting each island and tribal locale,
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
在德瓦他，我们相信有许多神灵守护着每个岛屿和部落地区，

scripts.text:
[Monk]
so we do have different manifestations of the Buddha, usually described as a bear, tiger, dragon, snake, or lion
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
因此我们有不同形态的佛陀，通常被描述为熊、虎、龙、蛇或狮子。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Great Lion is one of famous Buddhas worshipped in Dewata.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
大狮子是德瓦他供奉的著名佛陀之一。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Hope this was good explanation for you. Let me know if you have anything else you want to know.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
希望这个解释对您有帮助。如果您还有其他想知道的，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Good day to you...
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
祝您有美好的一天...

scripts.text:
[Monk]
This tower is built on the edge of coastal cliff. You can pray with a cool ocean breeze in your hair.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
这座塔建在海边的悬崖边缘。您可以在海风中祈祷，感受清凉的海风拂过发梢。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Come, you should feel the compassion of our Buddha in this pleasant weather.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
来吧，在这宜人的天气里，您应该能感受到我们佛陀的慈悲。

scripts.text:
[Lodge Owner]
These days, we have many honeymooners visiting here.
scripts.translation:
[旅舍老板]
最近，我们这里有很多度蜜月的情侣来访。

scripts.text:
[Lodge Owner]
It must be the beautiful scenery, right?
scripts.translation:
[旅舍老板]
一定是因为这里美丽的风景吧？

scripts.text:
[Lodge Owner]
I'm happy with my business. Hope all we have a lot more visitors like that.
scripts.translation:
[旅舍老板]
我的生意兴隆，真高兴。
希望我们这里能迎来更多像他们一样的客人。

scripts.text:
[Lodge Owner]
Ah! You should bring your lover to Dewata on your honeymoon.
I'll give you a good price-
scripts.translation:
[旅舍老板]
啊！您蜜月的时候应该带您的爱人来德瓦他。
我会给您一个优惠的价格——

scripts.text:
[Lodge employee]
Argg~ This is really ticking me off!
scripts.translation:
[旅舍员工]
啊~ 这真的让我很恼火！

scripts.text:
[Lodge employee]
How come more and more couples come here?
scripts.translation:
[旅舍员工]
为什么越来越多的情侣来这里？

scripts.text:
[Lodge employee]
And why do they have act so lovey-dovey? What's up with that?
scripts.translation:
[旅舍员工]
而且他们为什么非要表现得那么腻歪？这到底是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Lodge employee]
C'mon, show some respect to the people who work here...
scripts.translation:
[旅舍员工]
拜托了，请尊重一下在这里工作的人...

scripts.text:
[Sweet Husband]
You are the most beautiful thing in the world baby~
scripts.translation:
[恩爱的夫妇]
宝贝，你是世界上最美丽的人~

scripts.text:
[Sweet Wife]
Really? I'm that beautiful? I love you, honey~
scripts.translation:
[恩爱的夫妇]
真的吗？我那么美吗？我爱你，亲爱的~

scripts.text:
[Sweet Married Couple]
Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha
Hohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohoho
scripts.translation:
[恩爱的夫妇]
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈
呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵

scripts.text: Come on now, I'm growing tired of this. Let's go.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我有点累了。我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Sweet Wife]
Baby~ You know what flower that is~?
scripts.translation:
[温柔的妻子]
亲爱的~你知道那是什么花吗~？

scripts.text:
[Sweet Husband]
Hmm? I don't know. But it's really pretty.
scripts.translation:
[体贴的丈夫]
嗯？我不知道。但它真的很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Sweet Wife]
Baby~ Who's prettier, me or the flower?
scripts.translation:
[温柔的妻子]
亲爱的~我和花，谁更漂亮呢？

scripts.text:
[Sweet Husband]
No matter how pretty the flower is, you are always more beautiful~
scripts.translation:
[体贴的丈夫]
无论花多漂亮，你永远是最美的~

scripts.text:
[Sweet Wife]
Really? I'm that pretty? I love you, sweetie~
scripts.translation:
[温柔的妻子]
真的吗？我那么漂亮吗？亲爱的，我爱你~

scripts.text:
[Sweet Married Couple]
Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha
Hohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohoho
scripts.translation:
[恩爱的夫妇]
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈
呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵

scripts.text: Come on now, this bores me. Let's move on.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，真无聊。我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Reclining Tourist]
Wow~ This is really comfy~
scripts.translation:
[躺着的游客]
哇~这里真舒服~

scripts.text:
[Reclining Tourist]
I'm having a great time just relaxing.
scripts.translation:
[躺着的游客]
我就在这里放松，感觉棒极了。

scripts.text:
[Reclining Tourist]
You should lie down here too.
Once you do, you'll never want to get up.
scripts.translation:
[躺着的游客]
你也应该躺在这里。
一旦躺下，你就再也不想起来了。

scripts.text:
[Reclining Tourist]
That's why I haven't moved in a whole week! Hahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[躺着的游客]
所以我整整一周都没动过！哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey {0}, look at that man!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿 {0}，你看那个男人！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
He's been lying there for a week doin' nothin'...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
他就那么躺在那里，整整一周什么都没干...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Who IS that man?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
那个人到底是谁啊？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I don't want to be a lazybones like him when I grow up.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我长大后不想变成像他那样懒洋洋的人。

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
They're hiding so I should seek.
I'll find them for sure!-
scripts.translation:
[萨尔]
他们藏起来了，所以我要去找。
我一定会找到他们的！

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
One~
scripts.translation:
[萨尔]
一~

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
Two~ Three~
scripts.translation:
[萨尔]
二~ 三~

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
Four~ Five~ Six~
scripts.translation:
[萨尔]
四~ 五~ 六~

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
Ninty nine~ One hundred!!! Now I'm coming~
scripts.translation:
[萨尔]
九十九~ 一百！！！我来了哦~

scripts.text:
[Siyak]
Hey come on, move over~ He's gonna find me~~
scripts.translation:
[西雅克]
哎呀，快让开~ 他要找到我了~~

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
I found Siyak!! Come out, come out!!
scripts.translation:
[萨尔]
我找到西雅克了！！出来吧，出来吧！！

scripts.text:
[Siyak]
Arrgg!! This is all your fault~!!
scripts.translation:
[西雅克]
啊呜！！都怪你~！！

scripts.text:
[Sipo]
Sarr won't find me here, right?
scripts.translation:
[西波]
萨尔应该找不到我藏在这里吧？

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
I found Siyak!! Come out come out!!
scripts.translation:
[萨尔]
我找到西雅克了！！出来吧，出来吧！！

scripts.text:
[Sipo]
Hehe~ Now Siyak is IT~ I'll just keep hiding in here.
scripts.translation:
[西波]
嘿嘿~ 现在轮到西雅克找了~ 我就继续躲在这里。

scripts.text:
[Majya]
I was playing hide-and-seek with my friends...
scripts.translation:
[玛佳]
我和朋友们在玩捉迷藏...

scripts.text:
[Majya]
I've been just standing here, and they haven't found me for 3 hours...
scripts.translation:
[玛佳]
我就一直站在这里，他们三个小时都没找到我...

scripts.text:
[Majya]
What should I do? Come out? I don't want to be IT...
scripts.translation:
[玛佳]
我该怎么办？要出来吗？我不想当找人的人...

scripts.text:
[Ukki]
WaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaa~
scripts.translation:
[乌基]
哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, kid...

[Ukki]
WaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaa~
scripts.translation:
[乌基]
哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇~

scripts.text:
[Ukki]
Mama~ Papa~ Where are youuu~ Waa~
scripts.translation:
[乌基]
妈妈~ 爸爸~ 你们在哪里呀~ 哇~

scripts.text:
[Mum]
Ukki~ Ukki~ Where did she go?
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
乌基~ 乌基~ 她跑哪里去了？

scripts.text:
[Mum]
I can't take my eyes of her for a second...
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
我一刻都不能让她离开我的视线...

scripts.text:
[Mum]
Ukki~
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
乌基~

scripts.text:
[Poppa]
Honey, is Ukki lost again?
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
亲爱的，乌基又走丢了吗？

scripts.text:
[Poppa]
Arrgg... I can't go anywhere with her... How many times already?
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
啊...带着她我哪里都去不了...这已经是第几次了？

scripts.text:
[Daddy]
She's gotten lost in Luoyang, Amatsu, Moscovia, Brasilis, Kunlun,
and in Ayothaya...
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
她在洛阳、樱花城、莫斯科比亚、巴西、昆仑，
还有哎哟泰雅都走丢过...

scripts.text:
[Daddy]
What!! It's already been 7 times including this time in Dewata... 7 times!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
什么！！算上这次在德瓦他，已经7次了... 7次！！！！

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandpa]
Today, I should ask my lady to
cook me some ^006400fried rice^000000.
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老爷爷]
今天，我应该请我的夫人
给我做点^006400炒饭^000000。

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandpa]
My wife's ^006400fried rice^000000 is
always very special!
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老爷爷]
我夫人做的^006400炒饭^000000
总是非常特别！

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandpa]
It makes me love her even more.
You can't imagine the wonderful flavor!
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老爷爷]
这让我更加爱她了。
你无法想象那美妙的味道！

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandma]
In my younger days,
there were many gentleman callers
who wanted to court me.
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老奶奶]
在我年轻的时候，
有很多追求者想向我求婚。

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandma]
Yet, I met just the right guy,
and got married.
I asked what he likes best
about me, he said it was
my homemade ^006400fried rice^000000
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老奶奶]
但我遇到了对的人，
并结为了夫妻。
我问他最喜欢我什么，
他说是我做的^006400炒饭^000000

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandma]
And since then, he only asks me
to make ^006400fried rice^000000 for dinner.
Over 40 years of marriage
and he still doesn't get tired ot it.
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老奶奶]
从那以后，他晚餐只点^006400炒饭^000000。
结婚40多年了，
他依然吃不腻。

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandma]
I always think it was lucky
to be growing old with a guy
who loves what I cook.
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老奶奶]
我一直觉得，
能和一个喜欢我做的菜的人
一起变老，真是幸运。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Semangat]
I also traveled around the World
When I was young like you.
^FF0000Monkey, Cuttlefish^000000
^FF0000Eagle, and Snake^000000,
all were good friends I met
during my travels.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 塞曼加特]
我年轻时也像你们一样
环游过世界。
^FF0000猴子、乌贼^000000
^FF0000鹰和蛇^000000，
都是我在旅途中结识的好伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Semangat]
I still have passion for adventure and traveling.
But, I can't just leave
my beloved wife and
grandchildren behind...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 塞曼加特]
我依然对冒险和旅行充满热情。
但是，我不能就这样抛下
我深爱的妻子和
孙辈们...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Semangat]
You will also have something
or someone that is as precious
in your heart someday.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 塞曼加特]
总有一天，你心中也会拥有
像他们一样珍贵的人或事物。

scripts.text:
[Semangat's Wife]
Where's that old man
gone off to again?
Have you seen my husband around?
scripts.translation:
[塞曼加特的妻子]
那个老头子又跑哪去了？
你看到我丈夫了吗？

scripts.text: I think I saw him there..
scripts.translation: 我好像在那边看到他了。

scripts.text: No I haven't..
scripts.translation: 不，我没看到。

scripts.text:
[Semangat's Wife]
He ran away when
I was looking for him.
Should be somewhere, telling tall tales
to some travelers, like always.
scripts.translation:
[塞曼加特的妻子]
我找他时，他又跑掉了。
肯定又在给那些旅行者讲那些吹牛的故事，就像往常一样。

scripts.text:
[Semangat's Wife]
I apologize
on behalf of my husband.
Please don't believe his foolish stories
saying he met with ^FF0000Monkeys and Snakes^000000, or
that he fought alongside a ^FF0000Cuttlefish^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塞曼加特的妻子]
请替我丈夫向你们道歉。
请不要相信他那些胡话，
说什么他遇到了^FF0000猴子和蛇^000000，
或者和^FF0000乌贼^000000并肩作战。

scripts.text:
[Semangat's Wife]
He has been living here
for entire life.
Yet, always find some travelers,
and who will listen to his made-up tales.
scripts.translation:
[塞曼加特的妻子]
他在这里住了一辈子。
却总是能找到一些愿意听他编造故事的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Semangat's Wife]
Oh. Please let me know
if you ever see him around.
scripts.translation:
[塞曼加特的妻子]
哦。如果你看到他，请告诉我一声。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Isn't ^8B4513Dewata^000000 beach
really beautiful?
The children always play
at this beach. It really
reminds me of my youth.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
^8B4513德瓦他^000000的海滩
真的很美，不是吗？
孩子们总喜欢在这个海滩玩耍。
这真让我想起了我的青春岁月。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
At the evening, you can see
fireworks from the beach.
With ocean breeze, the crashing waves,
and fireworks lighting the sky,
the nighttime is a time of beauty here!
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
傍晚时分，你可以从海滩上看到烟花。
伴随着海风、拍岸的浪花，
以及照亮夜空的烟花，
这里的夜晚真是美不胜收！

scripts.text:
[Young Lady]
When you are outside of the town,
and meet ^FF0000Tiger, Monkey, or pig^000000,
make sure to avoid them.
scripts.translation:
[年轻女士]
如果你在城外，
遇到了^FF0000老虎、猴子或野猪^000000，
一定要避开它们。

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Young Lady]
I haven't seen yet,
but legend says there's a
cruel monster named ^FF0000Leak^000000
which can transform into an animal
and hypnotize people into killing.
scripts.translation:
[年轻女士]
我还没见过，
但传说有一种名叫^FF0000让特^000000的残忍魔物，
它能变成动物，
并催眠人们去杀人。

scripts.text:
[Young Lady]
You know the dangers of this world.
It's never hurts to be careful
even if it's just an urban legend.
scripts.translation:
[年轻女士]
你知道这个世界的危险。
即使那只是都市传说，
小心一点总没错。

scripts.text:
[Settler]
I'm not really from ^8B4513Dewata^000000.
But while traveling,
I found this place...
And made my decision
to live in this beautiful town.
scripts.translation:
[定居者]
我并不是^8B4513德瓦他^000000本地人。
但在旅行途中，
我发现了这个地方...
并决定在这座美丽的城镇定居。

scripts.text:
[Settler]
I've been happy to live here
and to find and experience
all these beautiful sights.
It's a dream come true.
scripts.translation:
[定居者]
我很高兴能住在这里，
发现并体验
所有这些美丽的风景。
这简直是梦想成真。

scripts.text:
[Settler]
Would you ever think of
settling here too?
scripts.translation:
[定居者]
你会考虑在这里定居吗？

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Ah~ I'm starving!!
I should be on a diet now.
Why am I still hungry?
scripts.translation:
[节食的女士]
啊~我饿死了！！
我现在应该在节食。
为什么我还是这么饿？

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Don't talk to me too much!!
I want to try that grilled ^006400Satay^000000
so much~!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[节食的女士]
别跟我说话！！
我好想吃那个烤^006400沙嗲^000000
啊~!!!!!

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Is that mouth-watering
^006400Satay^000000 for me?
scripts.translation:
[节食的女士]
那个让人垂涎欲滴的
^006400沙嗲^000000是给我的吗？

scripts.text: Yes, want a taste?
scripts.translation: 是的，想尝尝吗？

scripts.text: No, it's for me!
scripts.translation: 不，那是给我自己的！

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Thanks so much!
I've been so hungry~!!
This smell of this ^006400Satay^000000
is so good~!
scripts.translation:
[节食的女士]
太感谢了！
我饿死了~！！
这^006400沙嗲^000000的香味
真是太棒了~！

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Ah... gotta come back to my senses,
too much of a good thing is bad...
I should stick with my diet.
Sorry, I'll give it back to you.
scripts.translation:
[节食的女士]
啊...我得清醒一下，
过犹不及...
我还是得坚持节食。
抱歉，还给你。

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Arrgg.. You are so greedy!
Since you don't want to share.
Anyway, I shouldn't cheat on my diet
even for something that looks and smells so good...
scripts.translation:
[节食的女士]
啊...你太贪心了！
既然你不愿意分享。
不过，即使面对如此美味且香喷喷的东西，
我也不应该违背我的节食计划...

scripts.text:
[Dreaming Kid]
My granny says
There was once a bird named ^FF0000Garuda^000000
who flew above this town.
Afterwards we had some great harvests
and were able to live happily.
scripts.translation:
[做梦的孩子]
老奶奶说，
曾经有一只名叫^FF0000迦楼罗^000000的鸟
飞过这座城镇的上空。
之后我们迎来了大丰收，
过上了幸福的生活。

scripts.text:
[Dreaming Kid]
I want to see that bird
flying above our town again!
Then my mom, dad
granny, and grandpa
can be happy like the old times.
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[做梦的孩子]
我想再次看到那只鸟
飞过我们城镇的上空！
那样妈妈、爸爸、
老奶奶和老爷爷
就能像以前一样幸福了。
你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Energetic Kid]
My parents used to tell me...
scripts.translation:
[活泼的孩子]
我的父母以前常对我说...

scripts.text:
- ^006400Son,^000000 -
- ^006400You should study hard.^000000 -
- ^006400Be happy.^000000 -
- ^006400Live a slow^000000 -
- ^006400and safe life.^000000 -
- ^006400The mountain over yonder^000000 -
- ^006400will always be there for you.^000000 -

[Energetic Kid]
Isn't it a great philosophy?
I want to live that way
and become a great person,
and help all of the people in our town
live happily ever after!
scripts.translation:
[活泼的孩子]
这难道不是一种很棒的人生哲学吗？
我想这样生活，
成为一个伟大的人，
并帮助我们城镇里的所有人
永远幸福地生活下去！

scripts.text:
[Kid wishing to be an adult]
My family has been brewing
traditional Dewata wine for ages.
I want to drink it myself,
but my dad says I'm too young.
He said I can drink it
only after I sleep for over ^FF0000100 days^000000.
scripts.translation:
[想当大人的孩子]
我家世代酿造
传统的德瓦他酒。
我想自己尝尝，
但爸爸说我还太小。
他说只有在我睡了^FF0000100天^000000之后
才能喝。

scripts.text:
[Kid wishing to be an adult]
All grown-ups love to drink
my dad's wine.
I want to try some so bad.
But, what should I do...?
I've forgotten how many ^FF0000nights^000000
I've already slept... boo hoo!
scripts.translation:
[想当大人的孩子]
所有大人都喜欢喝
爸爸酿的酒。
我好想尝尝啊。
但是，我该怎么做呢...？
我忘了自己已经睡了^FF0000多少夜^000000了...呜呜！

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Gatekeeper]
Welcome to ^FF0000Jaty^000000 town.
Our tribe reveres strength and bravery.
We wish you a safe and restful time here.
scripts.translation:
[雅提部落守门人]
欢迎来到^FF0000雅提^000000镇。
我们的部落崇尚力量与勇气。
祝您在此度过安全而安宁的时光。

scripts.text:
[Reserved Jaty Warrior]
I want to be the very best
like no one ever was.
scripts.translation:
[沉默寡言的雅提战士]
我要成为无人能及的
最强者。

scripts.text:
[Reserved Jaty Warrior]
I'm learning hunting skills
these days. And I'm getting
better and better
every day!
scripts.translation:
[沉默寡言的雅提战士]
我最近正在学习狩猎技巧。
而且我每天都在
变得更强！

scripts.text:
[Reserved Jaty Warrior]
I won't stop until
I become a true warrior!
scripts.translation:
[沉默寡言的雅提战士]
在成为真正的战士之前，
我绝不会停下脚步！
